title: Orion, the Hunter
subtitle: A Greek myth: one version of the story
teaser: Meet Orion, a hunter from Greek myth, and find his pattern in the stars.
sourceNote: An original retelling following the scorpion account in Pseudo-Hyginus, Astronomica 2.26. Different ancient tellings exist. The landscape and narrative details are creative treatment, not historical evidence.

title: The Pleiades
subtitle: The Seven Sisters · A Greek sky story
teaser: Follow seven sisters and their mother from a quiet road to a place among the stars.
sourceNote: An original retelling following Pseudo-Hyginus, Astronomica 2.21.4 (2.21.6 in the UGA source collection), a Roman-era witness to a Greek tradition. The landscapes and gestures are modern adaptation. Other ancient versions exist.
coverAlt: Seven sisters together among clouds, in Elihu Vedder's painting The Pleiades, 1885.
